## Introduction

Molecule-based nanostructures presenting magnetic hysteresis at low temperature without undergoing three-dimensional magnetic ordering have provided a benchmark for the investigation of the dynamics of the magnetization at the Heisenberg model is a very important tool for the study of magnetic properties of materials. The most widely investigated systems are polynuclear clusters behaving like magnets, i.e., single-molecule magnets (SMM), but recently 1d structures have been demonstrated to be an new route to obtain magnetic memory of molecular nature. These systems have been named in analogy single-chain magnets (SCM). The thermal equilibrium spin dynamics of quasi 1d magnetic systems close to the ordering temperature has been widely investigated in the past, both from the experimental and theoretical point of gar.
